# Networking API

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_api.py from ZLS symbols and Zig doc comments. -->
<!-- Edit src/root.zig, then regenerate. Do not edit this file directly. -->

Direct-address GameNetworkingSockets bindings for Zig. Call `init()` before opening sockets and `deinit()` after closing every connection and listener and releasing every received message. Network operations use native handles; copying a `Connection`, `Listener`, or `Message` value does not create another owned handle.

This reference contains public declarations from `src/root.zig`.
ZLS supplies the symbol list; descriptions come from Zig `//!` and `///` comments.

## max_message_size

Largest payload accepted by `Connection.sendWith()` (512 KiB). TODO: Fix

## Error

Errors surfaced by the wrapper. Native send failures are translated into the most specific member available; other native failures use a general operation-specific error.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `InitializationFailed` | The native networking library could not initialize. |
| `NotInitialized` | A network operation was attempted before `init()`. |
| `InvalidAddress` | An address could not be parsed or accepted by the native library. |
| `InvalidHandle` | A connection, listener, or receive-group handle is invalid. |
| `InvalidState` | The connection is not in the state required by the operation. |
| `MessageTooLarge` | A send payload exceeds the supported size. |
| `SendQueueFull` | The native send queue is full. |
| `MessageDropped` | An unreliable message was dropped instead of queued. |
| `InvalidSendOptions` | `no_delay` was requested with reliable delivery. |
| `ListenFailed` | Creating a listen socket or poll group failed. |
| `ConnectFailed` | Starting an outgoing connection failed. |
| `AcceptFailed` | Accepting an incoming connection failed. |
| `BufferTooSmall` | The provided address-formatting buffer cannot hold the terminator. |
| `OperationFailed` | A native send operation failed for another reason. |

## Module functions

### `init`

`pub fn init() Error!void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L57)

Initialize the process-wide GameNetworkingSockets instance before using `listen()`, `connect()`, or other network operations. Repeated calls while initialized succeed. On `error.InitializationFailed`, call `initializationError()` for the native diagnostic.

### `initializationError`

`pub fn initializationError() []const u8` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L65)

Return the diagnostic text from the most recent failed `init()` call. The slice aliases process-wide storage and is cleared by a successful initialization; copy it if it must outlive another `init()` call.

### `deinit`

`pub fn deinit() void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L72)

Shut down GameNetworkingSockets. Close connections and listeners, release received messages, and stop network worker threads before calling this. Do not call it concurrently with another networking operation.

### `listen`

`pub fn listen(address: Address) Error!Listener` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L462)

Create a listen socket and poll group at `address`. Call `init()` first and `Listener.close()` when finished. Returns `error.NotInitialized` or `error.ListenFailed` on native failure.

### `connect`

`pub fn connect(address: Address) Error!Connection` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L477)

Start an outgoing connection to `address`. Call `init()` first, wait for a `.connected` event before application sends, and call `Connection.close()` when finished. Returns `error.NotInitialized` or `error.ConnectFailed` on native failure.

### `pollEvent`

`pub fn pollEvent() ?Event` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L491)

Dispatch native callbacks and remove the next connection-state event from the process-wide queue, or return `null` if none is ready. Use one polling thread when event order matters; multiple pollers divide the queue.

## Address

An IP address and port for `listen()` or `connect()`. Use the constructors to populate its native-compatible IP bytes.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `max_string_len` | Buffer size sufficient for any address plus its port and terminating zero when calling `toString()`. |
| `ip_bytes` | Native-compatible IPv4/IPv6 address bytes. |
| `port_number` | Host-order port number. |

### `parse`

`pub fn parse(text: []const u8) Error!Self` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L107)

Parse an IPv4 address such as `127.0.0.1:27020` or a bracketed IPv6 address such as `[::1]:27020`. Returns `error.InvalidAddress` for an invalid address, including text containing a zero byte.

### `any`

`pub fn any(port_number: u16) Self` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L116)

Construct the wildcard address for listening on local interfaces at `port_number`. Use this with `listen()` to accept remote peers.

### `ipv4`

`pub fn ipv4(octets: [4]u8, port_number: u16) Self` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L124)

Construct an IPv4 address from four octets and a port. TODO: Add the same for ipv6

### `localhost`

`pub fn localhost(port_number: u16) Self` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L139)

Construct the IPv4 loopback address `127.0.0.1` with the given port. TODO: ipv6

### `port`

`pub fn port(self: Self) u16` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L144)

Return this address's port number.

### `toString`

`pub fn toString(self: Self, buffer: []u8) Error![]const u8` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L152)

Format the address with its port into caller-owned `buffer`. The returned slice aliases `buffer` and excludes the terminating zero. Returns `error.BufferTooSmall` if the terminator would not fit; `max_string_len` bytes always suffice.

## ConnectionState

Native connection states reported by `pollEvent()`. Unknown native values remain representable through the non-exhaustive enum tag.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `none` | No known active state. |
| `connecting` | Incoming connection awaiting `Listener.accept()`, or outgoing setup. |
| `finding_route` | Native transport is finding a route to the peer. |
| `connected` | The connection is ready for application traffic. |
| `closed_by_peer` | The peer closed the connection. |
| `problem_detected_locally` | The local transport detected a connection problem. |

## Delivery

Delivery guarantee selected for a sent message.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `reliable` | Queue a message for reliable delivery. |
| `unreliable` | Permit loss instead of retransmitting the message. |

## SendOptions

Flags for `Connection.sendWith()`. The default sends reliably and permits the native library to briefly coalesce small messages.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `delivery` | Reliable by default; choose `.unreliable` when loss is acceptable. |
| `no_nagle` | Send immediately instead of briefly coalescing small messages. |
| `no_delay` | Drop an unreliable message if it cannot be sent immediately. Invalid with reliable delivery. |

## Connection

A connection handle returned by `connect()` or an incoming `Event`. A copy refers to the same native handle; close the owned connection once.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `handle` | Native connection identity. Zero means this value was closed. |

### `send`

`pub fn send(self: Self, data: []const u8) Error!void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L214)

Send one complete reliable message with default `SendOptions`. The payload must not exceed `max_message_size`; native send errors are returned as `Error` values.

### `sendUnreliable`

`pub fn sendUnreliable(self: Self, data: []const u8) Error!void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L220)

Send one complete unreliable message. Loss is possible; this call does not imply that the peer received the message.

### `sendWith`

`pub fn sendWith(self: Self, data: []const u8, options: SendOptions) Error!void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L228)

Send one complete message using explicit delivery and latency options. Returns `error.MessageTooLarge` above `max_message_size`, or `error.InvalidSendOptions` if `no_delay` is combined with reliable delivery. Other native send failures are translated into `Error`.

### `receive`

`pub fn receive(self: Self) Error!?Message` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L259)

Return the next complete message, or `null` when none is ready. The caller owns a returned message and must call `Message.release()` before `deinit()`. Returns `error.InvalidHandle` on a native receive error.

### `close`

`pub fn close(self: *Self) void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L272)

Close the native connection immediately and zero this value's handle. Calling it again on this value is harmless. Copies of this value are not invalidated and must not be closed again as separate owners.

### `isOpen`

`pub fn isOpen(self: Self) bool` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L281)

Test whether this value's handle is nonzero. This does not query the current network state; use `pollEvent()` for connection transitions.

### `eql`

`pub fn eql(self: Self, other: Self) bool` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L286)

Compare numeric native handle identities, not connection state.

### `id`

`pub fn id(self: Self) u32` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L292)

Return the numeric native identity for map keys or logs. It is unique only while the connection remains open.

## Listener

A listen socket and its receive poll group, returned by `listen()`. Closing the listener does not close accepted `Connection` handles; manage those separately.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `socket` | Native listen-socket identity; zero after `close()` on this value. |
| `poll_group` | Native receive-group identity for accepted connections. |

### `accept`

`pub fn accept(self: Self, connection: Connection) Error!void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L327)

Accept an incoming connection from a `.connecting` Event. The event must belong to this listener. Accepted connections are added to its poll group and become readable through `receive()`. Returns `error.InvalidHandle`, `error.InvalidState`, or `error.AcceptFailed` when the native accept operation fails.

### `receive`

`pub fn receive(self: Self) Error!?Message` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L343)

Return the next complete message from any accepted connection, or `null` when none is ready. The message's `connection` identifies its sender. The caller must `Message.release()` it before `deinit()`. Returns `error.InvalidHandle` on a native receive error.

### `close`

`pub fn close(self: *Self) void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L356)

Stop listening, destroy the poll group, and zero this value's handles. Calling it again on the same value is harmless. Copies of this value are not invalidated; close accepted connections separately.

### `isOpen`

`pub fn isOpen(self: Self) bool` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L366)

Test whether this value's listen-socket handle is nonzero. This does not query the native listener state.

### `id`

`pub fn id(self: Self) u32` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L371)

Return the numeric listen-socket identity, useful for event matching.

## Message

One complete received message, with a native-owned payload. Call `release()` once when finished; `data` must not be used afterward. Copying this struct does not duplicate ownership of the native message.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `data` | Payload bytes, valid only until `release()`. |
| `connection` | Connection that sent the message. |
| `connection_user_data` | Native per-connection user data attached to this message. |
| `received_at` | Native receive timestamp in microseconds. |
| `number` | Native message sequence number. |
| `reliable` | Whether the message was sent with reliable delivery. |
| `internal` | Opaque native message handle; callers should use `release()`. |

### `release`

`pub fn release(self: *Self) void` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L419)

Release the native message and invalidate `data` in this value. Repeating the call on the same value is harmless. Do not release a copied `Message` separately, and release before `deinit()`.

## Event

One connection-state transition removed from the process-wide event queue. Match `connection` to an owned handle or use `isFor()` for a listener.

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `connection` | Connection whose state changed. |
| `old_state` | State before the transition. |
| `state` | State after the transition. |
| `end_reason` | Native close or failure reason code. |
| `incoming` | Whether the event is associated with a listen socket. |
| `end_debug` | Zero-terminated native diagnostic text, usually useful on closure. |
| `listener_id` | Native listen-socket identity, or zero for an outgoing connection. |

### `endDebug`

`pub fn endDebug(self: *const Event) []const u8` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L448)

Return the diagnostic text up to its first zero byte. The slice aliases this event's `end_debug` array and is valid while the event lives.

### `isFor`

`pub fn isFor(self: *const Event, listener: Listener) bool` · [source](https://github.com/Zonotora/zgns/blob/main/src/root.zig#L454)

Return whether this event belongs to `listener`. Useful when polling the process-wide event queue for multiple listeners.
